4 BHK in Victory Valley: questions buyers ask

What is the price of a 4 BHK in IREO Victory Valley?

4 BHK flats for sale in IREO Victory Valley are listed between ₹5.70 Cr and ₹7.25 Cr, averaging ₹6.49 Cr, or about ₹20,700 per sq ft. Prices depend on floor, view, tower and condition.

What is the size of a 4 BHK in IREO Victory Valley?

Advertised 4 BHK flats measure 2,830–3,500 sq ft (super area). Most include a servant room.

How many 4 BHK flats are available for sale?

36 as of 1 Nov 2026. The list on this page is refreshed as new advertisements come in and sold flats are removed.

Can I see photos or a video before visiting?

Yes. Tap Enquire on any flat and Family&Flats will share photos and a short video on WhatsApp, usually within 24 hours, before you plan a visit.

Is the asking price final?

No. These are asking prices from the market (₹5.70–7.25 Cr). 6 listings have already reduced the price. The final price depends on floor, view, condition and how quickly you can close; Family&Flats shares recent deal context and negotiates on your behalf.

Is IREO Victory Valley ready to move?

Yes. IREO Victory Valley on Golf Course Extension Road is a completed, ready-to-move project, so these are resale homes you can move into after registry.
